name: ft_benchmark_f_scores
description: ft_benchmark_f_scores compiles fine-tuning evaluation results reported as F-scores across one or more NLP tasks, providing a consolidated view of model performance after task-specific fine-tuning. It is intended to facilitate comparison of models on classification and sequence-labeling benchmarks using F1-based metrics. The dataset/report focuses on F-score outcomes rather than raw predictions.
reputation: Small, user-contributed collection; limited adoption but useful for quick comparisons of fine-tuned model F-scores.
